state: Verified Canlang local saved-scenario API facts at dddebc1c. Normative docs/specification/DESIGN.md section4: completed membership removal prevents new admissions, already-admitted operations may finish; explicit subject roles must use current admission authorization and same commit fence as caller roles. Section5/7.1/10: saved mutation business result and changed records must obey current access/lifetime without body reevaluation. State current saved scalar projection checks exact retained receipt, app/owner/caller scope, checked source/model inventory, original/current secrets and current row grant predicates. It samples State revision before reading and after two matching projection passes. MembershipReader exposes ONLY findMembership(teamId,userId); Identity D1 each method is a single atomic statement but explicitly lacks shared State revision fence for multi-step operations. Membership updated_at uses supplied wall clock, is not a monotonic revision, and reactivation/setRoles can restore identical visible fields under a fixed clock. No atomic multi-member snapshot or global Identity revision producer is available. Caller members/owner consume a sampled Membership; declared caller/subject roles perform live reader lookup. Current API tracks each actually looked-up team/user membership snapshot, refuses differing samples and resamples all after final projection. Single-membership lookup is atomic; with stable State row revision, one authorized membership snapshot can supply a coherent authorized point during the request. Actual caller revocation during final projection is detected and owning regression passes. Multiple distinct memberships can oscillate: require caller A active AND subject B holding role; A active/B inactive during A reads, then A removed/B active during B reads, all samples compare equal, State revision unchanged, fixed timestamp restoration hides ABA. There need never be any point with the conjunction true. Merely revoking A after a final A read while later B is read could instead follow an earlier genuinely coherent admission; distinguish that permitted completion from the never-coherent counterexample. No consumer should invent authority or claim complete multi-subject qualification. Identity owner is Packages; roadmap owns saved projection and Dev genuine native/public bridge. Avoid endless rereads/global epoch redesign absent released owner contract. Need a precise useful safe boundary and necessary owner prerequisite, considering original/current field-grant unions, negative role tests and field dependency evaluation. These are source facts and a proposed interleaving, not a qualified multi-subject production exploit or acceptance.

authority_boundary.instructions: Given atomic individual membership reads but no atomic set/fence, which current disclosure profile should remain available while the exact owner prerequisite is missing?

criteria.retain_sequential_full_profile: Keep full multi-subject saved projection using existing repeated matching MembershipReader samples plus stable State revision, relying on an earlier authorized point. This preserves all current profiles without a new producer, but must actually exclude the verified never-coherent conjunction/ABA interleaving; equality alone may be insufficient.
criteria.single_authority_fact_until_owner_snapsh: Preserve zero/single distinct actual membership-fact profiles with existing current checks and final resampling. Withhold saved business/changed values when projection needs multiple distinct membership facts; explicitly keep full multi-subject scope unfinished until Identity owner supplies a bounded coherent multi-member read/snapshot contract. No global revision or extra reread loop is invented; precise safe supported scope, but broader legitimate results temporarily unavailable.
criteria.require_owner_coherent_snapshot_for_all: Withhold all membership-dependent saved scenario content until Identity owner supplies a bounded coherent membership snapshot integrated with State read checkpoint, even for one atomic lookup. Then use that producer for all original/current grants and result dependencies. Simplifies one uniform rule but blocks already useful single-member workflows; must justify why one atomic fact plus stable State facts has no sufficient authorized point.
